summary: MON ~$0.0193, -1.5% on the day. Negative items: a Name.com DNS hijack turned Kintsu (Monad liquid staking) and other sites into wallet drainers on 31 Oct, with ~5M MON tied to the attackers still parked on-chain (possible sell pressure), and a large token unlock (~140% of circulating supply, per one post) flagged for 24 Nov. Positive: Monad stablecoin pools more than doubled in Q3 to ~$871M after Aave launched. Leaning slightly negative.
